holdReasons: body-and-encoder-terms (blocked): The pinned code requires McGill-NLP/LLM2Vec-Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct-mntp-supervised for text encoding. That is a PEFT adapter (gated false, licence mit) whose adapter_config.json declares base model meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, which HuggingFace reports as gated "manual" under licence "llama3". Obtaining it requires an account and acceptance of a licence this repository does not hold. Accepting a new gated term is an owner decision, not this card's.

training-data-rights (unresolved): Split by variant, and neither variant's data terms are first-party inspectable from here. RP is trained on the "Proprietary Bones Rigplay Dataset" whose terms are not published. SEED is trained on the "Public Bones-SEED Dataset", but that dataset is gated "auto" on HuggingFace under licence "other", so its licence text sits behind a gate this repository does not hold. NVIDIA asserts provenance and commercial readiness on the model cards; that assertion was read but not independently verified.

local-execution (blocked): Motion inference cannot run on this host: the model card's supported operating systems are Linux, Windows, and this host is macOS; no CUDA device is present on Apple M1 Max. The README's CPU offload does not change this — it moves only the text embedding model and still leaves the denoiser needing GPU VRAM.
encounter.nextUnblock: Owner decision on two terms, then a CUDA host. (1) Accept, or refuse, the Meta Llama 3 Community License for meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, which the pinned code's text encoder requires; this card may not accept it. (2) Accept the NVIDIA Open Model License, which binds on use. (3) Provide a Linux or Windows host with a CUDA GPU (>=3 GB VRAM with TEXT_ENCODER_DEVICE=cpu, or >=17 GB fully on GPU) under existing authorization. Then screen Kimodo-SOMA-SEED-v1.1 first, since it is the open-training-data variant.

The README's "somaskel77" statement describes the library's I/O surface; the model card's 30 describes the checkpoint's native joint count. At the pinned code revision both SOMASkeleton30 and SOMASkeleton77 are exported and SOMASkeleton30.output_to_SOMASkeleton77 expands the 30-joint output to 77 joints by filling the relaxed-hand rest pose and re-running FK. The two documents describe different layers of one pipeline, so neither is stale.
